orca worktree rm

Usage: orca worktree rm --worktree <selector> [--force] [--run-hooks] [--json]

Remove a worktree from Orca and git

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code
  --environment
  --worktree <selector>  Worktree selector such as id:<repo-id>::<path>, name:<displayName>, branch:<branch>, issue:<number>, path:<path>, or active/current
  --force                Force worktree removal when supported
  --run-hooks

Notes:
  Repo-defined orca.yaml archive hooks are skipped unless --run-hooks is passed.
